nodes.name: Anodic dissolution in electrochemical cell
nodes.procedure: Anode chamber (cylindrical, internal diameter 8 mm, solution volume ~500 μL) with anion selective membrane film 'SELEMION AMV' at bottom. Strip working electrode of Fe (2×2×10 mm3) anodically dissolved by galvanostatic electrolysis at 5 mA using Pt counter electrode. Saturated (~5.5 M) or 0.52 M NaCl solutions at 30°C under air-bubbling. pH measured by micro-pH electrode. After 1.5×10^5 s, precipitates removed, dried at 30°C oven, half washed with deionized water, filtered, characterized by XRD (Rigaku RINT 2500 HL/PC, Co target, 30 kV–100 mA, 2° min^-1).
